subtitle: Backend Engineer (Go) at Müller & Söhne Software GmbH
body: Software that makes supply chains reliable has interested me since university: my final project showed me how much a well-modelled data flow means to the people who work with it every day. I see exactly that impact in your logistics platform.

Why backend development? I am motivated by interfaces and data models that have to last for years. In my current role for a non-profit organisation I own the REST API and the database, and I see how good early decisions make later changes easier.

Why your company? You use Go and PostgreSQL, publish your architecture decisions openly and work in small, autonomous teams. That is the environment in which I want to learn to own a service from design to operation.

What I bring: experience with Docker Compose and GitHub Actions, care for tests, and the willingness to learn new tools quickly. Sharing knowledge clearly matters to me just as much, as I did as a student assistant in the database lab.
In the long run I want to settle in Mannheim and the region and work on systems that grow over years. I look forward to meeting you in person.
